cancellationReason.description:
Reason for cancellation. Example: 'CUSTOMER_REQUESTED_SELLER_TO_CANCEL'.

Cancellation reason should not be "CUSTOMER_REQUESTED_SELLER_TO_CANCEL" for non intent to cancel orders'

Cancellation reason should not be
"SELLER_CANCEL_FRAUD_STOP_SHIPMENT" for non fraudulent orders. If you suspect fraud, contact Walmart Risk Prevention Team (MPFraudReq@customercare.walmart.com). Include PO details and reason you suspect the order. We will contact you in 2-4 hours. If your suspicion of fraud is proven, we will cancel the order and notify you.

If you select the cancellation reason as "SELLER_CANCEL_OUT_OF_STOCK", Walmart will mark the specific item as out of stock in the selected warehouse. To make the item available for sale again, please replenish its inventory.

description: Read and fulfill US Marketplace orders, manage inventory and prices, inspect items, feeds and returns.

walmart_marketplace_new_order_trigger.description: Runs for each new order in Walmart Marketplace. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
